signature.description: Base64 (standard, padded) signature over the raw file bytes.

description:
`<file>.sig` next to every signed metadata file (§13.4). Each signature covers the exact raw bytes of the
file as served (no re-serialization), so verification never depends on JSON canonicalization.

signatures.description: Several signatures allow key rotation: during a rotation the release is signed by the old and new key.

title: SignatureFile
